semantic.justification: Task6764KT connects actual registered CSS FontFaces to unique active same-origin CSSOM declarations, preserving ambiguity as unknown rather than selecting guessed glyph data. Source URLs use actual stylesheet bases and CSS string decoding; disabled/opaque/inactive sheets,duplicate descriptors,local/fallback/unsupported format/technology sources are not guessed. FontList retains source URLs, reads only on demand, waits for actual face.load and propagates HTTP/load failures. Chromium witnesses run actual repository exports over production Writer/Calc pages; unit CSSOM descriptor ports explicitly compensate for jsdom dropping font-face-only descriptors and are not native browser evidence. Actual font cmap/capability readers,native regular-face choice and visual font/style dropdown integration remain unfinished; no full parity/default promotion.
